title: Near copy of bank digit weight
statement: How many positive integers less than $10^{18}$ have decimal digits that sum to $3$ and are divisible by $37$?
hints: Name the units digit, since the tens digit depends on it.
Use the place value of each digit to list the options: the tens digit is at most $9$, which limits the units digit.
solution: Powers of $10$ have residues $1$, $10$ and $26$ modulo $37$ in turn, and a sum of three powers is divisible by $37$ exactly when the three positions are distinct modulo $3$. With $6$ positions in each class there are $6^3 = 216$ such numbers. Why this works. place-value-representation: the tens digit is at most nine, which limits the units digit.
check_program:
from itertools import combinations_with_replacement as c
print(len({sum(10 ** i for i in p) for p in c(range(18), 3) if sum(10 ** i for i in p) % 37 == 0}))
